scoring_note: Momentum + Novelty + Resonance, 1-10 each. Sanity floor 22. Two window picks (RuView 05-31, Odysseus 06-01) excluded as already featured in Issue 4.

scores.rationale: +4,045 stars in 2 days (~2k/day), HN and press run, v0.23 shipped June 4. Reversible CCR compression is a real differentiator. Netflix storage engineer applying a storage-budget instinct to the context window is the cleanest narrative of the week, and it embodies the connective-tissue through-line.
Flat stars but the actual shipping-now story (v3.4 Remote Control, June 2-6). The framework the rest of the week's MCP servers are built on, folded into the official SDK. The thesis spine.
+2,887 stars in 4 days on a 61k base. Adaptive relocation is clever, and the built-in MCP server puts it squarely in the agent-reach lane, but the project predates the wave (Oct 2024).
Show HN front page (100 points, 74 comments) and ~109 Product Hunt upvotes on launch day. A cloud machine per agent is a real pain fix, but it's a closed hosted product with no open repo.
28,392 stars but the +731/day tribute velocity has cooled to flat; the trending badge is lagging. Cross-platform convergence detection is the novel idea. Anti-recommendation candidate on momentum.
